finding.comment: The docstring asserts an exclusive resolution guarantee: every entrypoint resolves the workspace root through this resolver and no other mechanism. The resolver is introduced here with no consumer anywhere in the change, so the claim about all entrypoints is unsubstantiated by this diff. Since documenting this contract is the PR's stated purpose, the unverifiable absolute claim is the defect.

input.title: cli: document workspace-root resolution contract
input.body: Documents how the workspace root is resolved.

files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/cli/paths.py
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+"""Workspace-root resolution contract.
+
+Every entrypoint resolves the workspace root through this
+resolver and no other mechanism.
+"""
+
+class WorkspaceRoot:
+    @staticmethod
+    def resolve():
+        raise NotImplementedError

rationale: universal claim over all entrypoints while the change contains no consumer of the resolver
